[LCST.4.1.4] **Precedence.** Because `::` is a postfix operator, it interleaves with
member/method access left to right and binds tighter than every unary and binary operator.
Thus `R.v::Int.bit_count` is `(R.v::Int).bit_count`, `R.temp::Float > x` is
`((R.temp)::Float) > x`, and `x::Int? ?? 0` is `(x::Int?) ?? 0`.
